GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: began well, Went Forward raced keenly in 3rd 2 Lengths . Straightened Up in Clear 3 Lengths from the Leader /winner, Battled On Well enough for 3rd # boxed on okay
Slow Out 1 length Settled Down Off Mid-Field 3wide With Cover 7l much the same to straightening up battled on one pace to the line # even effort

jumped out fine. soon Went Forward but on heels on rail. came out Two Wide 5th, 4 Lengths @ 750m. Held Up entering Straight then found Clear Two Wide 250m. came Through soundly last furlong but Just outgunned # Sound once Clear
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in early stages and near 800m was eased when close to heels. Held up for clear running rounding the home turn. Near 150m dipped and became unbalanced.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: fractious barriers Jumped Ok Settled Down 3 Wide No Cover Outside Leaders 1 length then 2 Lengths home turn 1.5l stuck on solidly after working deep on pace # hard run 3 Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Pre-race vet exam of gelding, which was fractious in the barriers – suitable to race. Raced three wide without cover throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 3-4 Lengths & went Straight Out The Back 9 Lengths . Hooked Out Wide in Straight , ran home mostly Hands And Heels # slow start costly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: reared as the start was affected and as a result was slow to begin  (approximately 4 lengths). Trainer, Ms B. O’Loughlin, was advised that a warning had been placed  on the gelding in relation to its barrier manners

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Ridden Along three back rails 4 Lengths 700m, Saved Ground hard on fence soon after Straightening Up , battled on well to be Just out of placings # battled on rails
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event. Near the  700m was steadied when awkwardly placed on the heels of another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to 2nd 1 length . hit front Soon After Straightening Up , overhauled @ 200m, Quickly Battling # had her chance
jumped ok but Quickly Eased back Settled Down Wide and last all of 7 Lengths @ 650m. to 10th on Straightening Up but was never looming in Straight Just Held Ground # always well back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide throughout.  Hung out near the 600m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok was out 3 Wide No Cover 3rd 2 Lengths . moved up to challenge for Lead on Straightening Up , laid in near 100m, began to tire Soon After & was grabbed for 3rd (vet -no visible abnormalities) # Wide run Took toll
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: . A post-race veterinary examination revealed no visible abnormalities. Warned - Barrier manners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok raced bit keenly in 5th 2 Lengths . raced in restricted room on Straightening Up until approaching 100m, worked Through late to finish 3rd # not clearest path
Jumped Ok Settled 3rd on rail 5 Lengths . Same to Straightening Up , only really Held Ground to line # could do no better
Jumped Ok went to 3rd out 3 Wide 1 length . Same to Straightening Up , Battled On Well but couldn't get to the winner who held the fence throughout # wide/tried hard
